value: Integrated TAM + Sociocultural Theory (SCT) on university EFL instructors across four countries (Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Mexico, Turkey). Total N=307 surveyed; analytic sample N=210 (those actively deploying GenAI in classrooms, confirmed via regression df: F(1,208), F(3,204)). Cross-sectional online survey; 7-point Likert; analysis via stepwise multiple regression + one-way ANOVA + Scheffé post-hoc + Pearson correlations (SPSS v26). SEM discarded due to inadequate fit (RMSEA=.718, CMIN/DF=108.6, CFI=.177). Construct mapping to target 12: PEU (Perceived Ease of Use)→EE, PU (Perceived Usefulness)→PE, IU (Intention to Use)→BI, AU (Actual Use)→UB, FC (Facilitating Conditions)→FC, PT (Perceived Trust)→TRU, ATT (Attitude)→ATT. CPB (Constructivist Pedagogical Beliefs) and TPB (Transmissive Pedagogical Beliefs) — outside the target 12-construct framework, not coded. CMB not explicitly addressed (no Harman's/CMV test reported). Correlations extracted from §4.3.1 text (p.8); only 6 inter-construct correlations explicitly reported in narrative: PEU-PU, PEU-IU, PU-IU, IU-AU, PEU-FC, PEU-PT. Full correlation matrix is referenced as Appendix F Table F1 but is not in the main PDF — located in supplementary online data (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.system.2025.103861). Significance: 4 pairs explicitly tagged p<.01 in narrative (PEU-PU, IU-AU, PEU-FC, PEU-PT); PEU-IU and PU-IU narratively implied p<.01 but not explicitly stated → coded p<.01 by paragraph context. 6 of 66 target pairs fillable from main PDF. Flagged for construct-framework mismatch (pedagogical beliefs outside target list) and incomplete matrix extraction (full matrix in supplementary).
